brief.headline: Push price toward ₹0.65–0.80/pc (market fair-range floor) and qualify Manjushree or Mold-Tek as a second source to tighten our supply and sharpen future bids

priceAsk.summary: Ask for pricing in the ₹0.65–0.80/pc range for the 28 mm cap at higher volumes
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc; market verdict is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — so we anchor to that lower band

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep current 30 Days After Receipt; no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: Empire publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or cash position. That means we build our case on the open-market price bands and on having a second source ready. Our ₹67.47 L annual spend is meaningful leverage if we can credibly shift volume. Since we don't know how tight their cash is, we lead on price and supply security rather than payment pressure.

evidence.point: Market asking price for 28 mm PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
Market verdict says MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec
HDPE resin import unit value stands at 87.61 ₹/kg, giving us a raw-material reference line
We spend ₹67.47 L a year with them — enough volume to earn better-than-typical pricing

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate and a strong negotiating card

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹946.50 Cr revenue, health B 73/100) for pails, containers, pharma — robust, profitable alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited
alternates.role: a lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — pan-India manufacturer, medium confidence

risks: Empire's financials aren't public, so we can't gauge how fragile or cash-hungry they are — pushing too hard without that view could destabilize a sole source
We have no internal price benchmark (no best-price-we-pay figure), so our ask rests entirely on the open-market band — verify that band with a second quote before the meeting
Alternates Manjushree and Mold-Tek are qualified on paper but not yet priced or audited for our SKUs — line up an RFQ in parallel so Empire knows we're serious
If Empire's margins are thin and hidden, a sudden 15–20 % price cut to ₹0.65–0.80 might force them to cut corners on quality or delivery — watch lead-times and spec compliance closely
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to bring our 28 mm cap pricing into the ₹0.65–0.80 range that the market shows is achievable at our volume, and at the same time we're qualifying a second source to make sure we have supply security and competitive tension going forward.
